Example Corp. reported revenue growth of 7.5% to $1.20 billion.

Operating expenses increased by 12%, and margins declined by 2.3 percentage points.

The company did not reduce its FY2025 revenue guidance.

EPS rose to $1.42, but management warned of weaker demand.

Cash flow was positive, although net debt remained at $450 million.
